__comment: Your Emby server's films and series in Videos. Signs in with your Emby user; Videos and Emby keep each other's place. The customUI app org.webosports.app.videoauth asks for what the provider needs and calls org.webosports.service.videos/login with this templateId, which checks it before Accounts stores the account.
__comment2: org.webosports.app.videoauth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs as the customUI app. org.webosports.service.videos reads the credentials for every catalogue call. org.webosports.app.music.service (the Music app's daemon) only reads them, to play the server's music in Music.
